In this notebook, I will compile Milo and cell frequency data into a single Excel file

# Setup

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(scales)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggbreak)

colFGID <- "#1E88E5"
coliCD <- "#55D276"
colcCD <- "#FFC107"
colUC <- "#D81B60"
colIBD <- "#EB6D33"

celltypes.renamed <- c(
  "Colonic Epithelium" = "ColEpi", 
  "Stroma" = "Stroma", 
  "Myeloid" = "Myeloid", 
  "Plasma Cells" = "Plasma", 
  "B Cells" = "BCell", 
  "T Cells, NK Cells, and ILCs" = "TNKILC")

thisseed <- 231103

diagSubColVec <- c("FGID"=colFGID, "iCD" = coliCD, "cCD"=colcCD, "UC"=colUC)

diagSub.comp <- list(c("FGID", "cCD"), c("iCD", "cCD"), c("cCD", "UC"), c("FGID", "UC"))

colNM <- "#6b6a6a"
colNOA <- "#bfbfbf"
colFR <- "#11d6cc"
colPR <- "#ff8c00"
colNR <- "#ff1e00"
atnfColVec <- c("NM"=colNM, "NOA"=colNOA,"FR"=colFR,"PR"=colPR,"NR"=colNR)


source("../functions/ComparisonPlottingFxns.R")

selectedparticipants.hla <- c("001-036", "001-038")

`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)
```


# scRNA-Seq Frequencies

## ColEpi

```{r}
freq.colepi <- PlotBoxplotsProp(
  obs %>% filter(timepoint == "T0") %>% droplevels,
  ann.col = "cellstate",
  filterCol = "cellstate",
  filterVal = c("Colonocyte", "Inflm. Col.", "Goblet", "Inflm. Gob.", "CCL24+ Gob.", "LGR5+ Epi.", "SAA+ Epi."),
  relative.to = "celltype",
  xVar = "diagSub",
  fillVar = "antitnf_response",
  minDenomFreq = 10,
  exportDF = T
) %>% 
  rename(
    Annotation = cellstate,
    RelGroup = celltype,
    Annotation_Count = annotation.freq,
    RelGroup_Count = denominator.freq,
    Proportion = prop
  ) %>% 
  relocate(biopsy, diagSub, antitnf_response, 
           Annotation, RelGroup, Annotation_Count, RelGroup_Count, Proportion) %>% 
  arrange(Annotation, diagSub, antitnf_response, biopsy)

freq.colepi
```

## Pre vs. Post

```{r}
freq.prepost <- PlotBoxplotsProp(
  obs %>% 
    mutate(atnf = paste(diagSub, antitnf, sep = ".")) %>%
    mutate(ibd.atnf = case_when(
      diagSub == "FGID" ~ "FGID",
      diagSub == "iCD" ~ "iCD",
      diagSub == "cCD" & timepoint != "T0" & antitnf_response %in% c("FR", "PR", "NR") ~ "PostTx cCD",
      diagSub == "cCD" & timepoint != "T0" & antitnf_response %notin% c("FR", "PR", "NR") ~ "Other.cCD",
      diagSub == "cCD" & timepoint == "T0" ~ "PreTx cCD",
      diagSub == "UC" ~ "UC",
    )) %>%
    mutate(ibd.atnf = fct_relevel(ibd.atnf, c("FGID", "iCD", "Other.cCD", "PreTx cCD", "PostTx cCD", "UC"))) %>%
    filter(diagSub != "UC") %>% 
    filter(!(diagSub == "iCD" & timepoint == "R")) %>% 
    filter(ibd.atnf != "Other.cCD" & timepoint != "R2") %>% 
    filter(!(diagSub == "cCD" & antitnf_response %notin% c("FR", "PR", "NR"))) %>% 
    droplevels,
  ann.col = "cellstate",
  filterCol = "cellstate",
  filterVal = c("Th1", "TFPI2Hi Fibro.", "Inflm. Mac", "Treg", "XCL+ NK", "MNP", "Th17"),
  relative.to = "celltype",
  xVar = "ibd.atnf",
  fillVar = "antitnf_response",
  fillVector = ibdAtnfColVec,
  testComp = ibdonlyAtnf.comp,
  minDenomFreq = 10,
  exportDF = T
) %>% 
  mutate(antitnf_response = fct_relevel(antitnf_response, c("FR", "PR"))) %>% 
  mutate(cellstate = fct_relevel(cellstate, c("Th1", "TFPI2Hi Fibro.", "Inflm. Mac", "Treg", "XCL+ NK", "MNP", "Th17")))  %>% 
  rename(
    Annotation = cellstate,
    RelGroup = celltype,
    diagSub_timepoint = ibd.atnf,
    Annotation_Count = annotation.freq,
    RelGroup_Count = denominator.freq,
    Proportion = prop
  ) %>% 
  relocate(biopsy, diagSub_timepoint, antitnf_response, 
           Annotation, RelGroup, Annotation_Count, RelGroup_Count, Proportion) %>% 
  arrange(Annotation, diagSub_timepoint, antitnf_response, biopsy)

freq.prepost
```

### UC HLA

```{r}
hla.out <- PlotBoxplotsProp(
  obs %>% 
    filter(timepoint == "T0" & diagSub == "UC") %>% 
    droplevels,
  ann.col = "cellstate",
  filterCol = "cellstate",
  filterVal = c(
    "SAA+ Epi.",
    "IgA2 PC", "IgG1 PC",
    "Th17", "PD1Hi Tfh"
    ),
  relative.to = "celltype",
  minDenomFreq = 10,
  exportDF = T
) %>%
  mutate(participant_id = str_split(biopsy, "_", simplify = T)[,1]) %>% 
  mutate(partCol = ifelse(participant_id %in% selectedparticipants.hla, participant_id, NA)) %>% 
  mutate(partCol = fct_relevel(partCol, selectedparticipants.hla)) %>% 
  mutate(DRB1 = ifelse(participant_id %in% selectedparticipants.hla, "15:01", "Other")) %>% 
  mutate(DRB1 = fct_relevel(DRB1, c("15:01", "Other"))) %>% 
  mutate(alleleNum = case_when(
    participant_id == "001-036" ~ "2",
    participant_id == "001-038" ~ "1",
    participant_id %notin% c("001-036", "001-038") ~ "0",
  )) %>% 
  rename(
    Annotation = cellstate,
    RelGroup = celltype,
    Annotation_Count = annotation.freq,
    RelGroup_Count = denominator.freq,
    Proportion = prop,
    `HLA-DRB1` = DRB1,
    Num_1501_Alleles = alleleNum,
  ) %>% 
  relocate(biopsy, diagSub, `HLA-DRB1`, Num_1501_Alleles,
           Annotation, RelGroup, Annotation_Count, RelGroup_Count, Proportion) %>% 
  select(-participant_id, -partCol) %>% 
  arrange(Annotation, `HLA-DRB1`, biopsy)

hla.out
```
